title: [Survey] Enter weekly grocery budget
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to enter my weekly grocery budget so that every plan I get stays within what I can spend.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Survey has a numeric budget input that rejects empty, zero, or negative values
- [ ] The saved budget is passed to plan generation as a hard limit

title: [Survey] Mark busy days and cooking time per day
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to mark which days are busy and how much time I have to cook each day so that meals fit around my schedule.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can set a busy/free flag and available cooking minutes for each day of the week
- [ ] Generated meals on each day do not exceed that day's cooking time
display_title: [Survey] Mark busy days and cooking time per day

title: [Survey] Select dietary restrictions and allergies
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to choose my dietary restrictions and allergies from a short list so that I never get meals I can't eat.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Survey offers a short multi-select list (e.g. vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut allergy, dairy-free)
- [ ] No generated meal contains an ingredient that violates a selected restriction

title: [Survey] Set nutrition or fitness goal
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to set a nutrition or fitness goal (e.g., high protein, calorie target) so that my plan supports what I'm working toward.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can pick a goal such as high protein, or enter a daily calorie target
- [ ] The chosen goal is used when generating and verifying the plan

title: [Survey] Free-text preferences
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to describe extra preferences in my own words (e.g., "no fish, I hate cooking on Mondays") so that I'm not limited to fixed checkboxes.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Survey has a free-text field for extra preferences
- [ ] The text is interpreted and applied to the plan, not just stored

title: [Survey] List pantry items
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to list what's already in my pantry so that the plan uses it before buying new ingredients.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can add and remove pantry items, with an optional quantity
- [ ] Plan generation prefers meals that use pantry items

title: [Survey] Short initial survey
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to finish the initial survey in a few minutes so that setup doesn't feel like a 50-question quiz.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Survey can be completed in about 3 minutes or less
- [ ] Non-essential sections (e.g. goal, free text, pantry) can be skipped

title: [Survey] Edit survey answers later
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to edit my survey answers later so that I don't have to start over when my situation changes.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] All survey answers can be viewed and edited after initial setup
- [ ] Saved edits apply to the next plan that is generated or regenerated

title: [Plan] Generate a full week of meals
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want a full week of meals generated from my survey so that I don't have to plan them myself.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Submitting the survey produces a plan covering all 7 days
- [ ] The plan reflects survey inputs (budget, schedule, restrictions, goal, preferences)
display_title: [Plan] Generate a full week of meals

title: [Plan] Verify plan against budget before display
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want each plan checked against my budget before I see it so that I can trust it won't overspend.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] A plan whose total estimated cost exceeds the budget is never shown
- [ ] A failed check triggers regeneration or an explanatory message
display_title: [Plan] Verify plan against budget before display

title: [Plan] Verify plan against restrictions and free-text requests
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want each plan checked against my restrictions and free-text requests so that what I asked for is actually reflected, not just saved.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] A verification step checks every meal against restrictions, allergies, and free-text preferences
- [ ] A plan that fails verification is regenerated or flagged, not shown as valid
display_title: [Plan] Verify plan against restrictions and free-text requests

title: [Plan] Share ingredients across meals
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want meals to share ingredients across the week so that I buy less and waste less food.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Plan generation favors meals with overlapping ingredients
- [ ] Ingredients are consolidated across meals in the totals

title: [Plan] Show cost per meal and weekly total
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to see the estimated cost of each meal and the week's total so that I know where my money is going.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Each meal displays an estimated cost
- [ ] The week's total cost is displayed alongside the budget
display_title: [Plan] Show cost per meal and weekly total

title: [Plan] Clear message when constraints can't be met
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want a clear message when my constraints can't all be met (e.g., budget too low for my goals) so that I know what to adjust instead of getting a broken plan.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] When no valid plan exists, the app shows which constraint(s) conflict
- [ ] The message suggests what to change, and no invalid plan is displayed
display_title: [Plan] Clear message when constraints can't be met

title: [Calendar] Weekly calendar view of meals
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to see my meals laid out on a weekly calendar so that I know what I'm eating each day at a glance.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Calendar shows all 7 days with each day's meals
- [ ] Layout is readable on both desktop and mobile

title: [Calendar] Schedule prep blocks on less busy days
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want prep blocks scheduled on my less busy days so that cooking fits into my real week.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Prep blocks appear on the calendar and are placed on days marked free or less busy
- [ ] Prep blocks never land on days with insufficient cooking time
display_title: [Calendar] Schedule prep blocks on less busy days

title: [Calendar] Open a meal to see recipe details
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to open a meal to see its recipe, cook time, and ingredients so that I can cook it without searching elsewhere.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Selecting a meal opens a detail view with recipe steps, cook time, and ingredients
- [ ] Detail view can be closed and returns to the calendar
display_title: [Calendar] Open a meal to see recipe details

title: [Day controls] Mark a day as changed
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to mark a day as changed (e.g., "eating out Thursday") so that the plan adapts when my week changes.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can mark any day as changed or skipped (e.g. eating out)
- [ ] The plan adapts, e.g. no meal for that day and ingredients adjusted
display_title: [Day controls] Mark a day as changed

title: [Day controls] Pin meals to keep on regenerate
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to pin meals I like so that they stay when I regenerate.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can pin and unpin any meal
- [ ] Pinned meals remain unchanged after regeneration
display_title: [Day controls] Pin meals to keep on regenerate

title: [Day controls] Regenerate week with one click
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to regenerate the week with one click so that I get a new plan without redoing the survey.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] A single Regenerate action produces a new plan from saved survey answers
- [ ] Day changes and pins are respected
display_title: [Day controls] Regenerate week with one click

title: [Day controls] Re-verify regenerated plans
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want regenerated plans re-verified against my budget and constraints so that changes don't quietly break them.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Every regenerated plan passes the same budget and constraint checks as the initial plan
- [ ] Failures show the same clear message as initial generation

title: [Day controls] Swap a single meal
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to swap a single meal so that I can replace one I don't like without changing the whole week.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can request a replacement for one meal and the rest of the week is unchanged
- [ ] The replacement is verified and updates cost and grocery list

title: [Grocery] Generate grocery list from plan
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want a single grocery list generated from my plan so that I can do one shopping trip.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] One consolidated list is generated from all meals in the plan
- [ ] Duplicate ingredients are merged with combined quantities

title: [Grocery] Exclude pantry items from list
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want the list to exclude items already in my pantry so that I don't buy duplicates.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Items covered by pantry quantities do not appear on the list
- [ ] Partially covered items show only the amount still needed

title: [Grocery] Group list by store section
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want the list grouped by store section so that shopping is faster.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Items are grouped under sections such as produce, dairy, meat, and pantry
- [ ] Each item appears under exactly one section

title: [Grocery] Check off items while shopping
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to check items off as I shop so that I can track what I still need.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can check and uncheck items
- [ ] Check state persists across reloads

title: [Grocery] Send list to Instacart
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want the option to send my list to Instacart so that I can get delivery when I don't have time to go to the store.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] An optional Send to Instacart action hands off the grocery list
- [ ] Errors or an unavailable Instacart connection are handled with a clear message

title: [Check-in] Mark meals cooked or skipped
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to mark meals as cooked or skipped so that the app knows what I actually ate.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Each meal can be marked cooked or skipped
- [ ] Status is saved and visible on the calendar

title: [Check-in] Rate cooked meals
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want to rate meals I cooked so that future plans include more of what I like.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] User can rate a meal after marking it cooked
- [ ] Ratings influence which meals are chosen in future plans

title: [Check-in] Weekly check-in
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want a short check-in at the end of the week so that next week's plan learns from how this one went.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] A short check-in (a few questions) is offered at the end of the week
- [ ] Responses are used when generating next week's plan

title: [Check-in] Carry leftover pantry items into next week
body:
**User story**
As a student, I want leftover pantry items from this week carried into next week's plan so that food doesn't go to waste.

**Acceptance criteria** _(suggested; edit as needed)_
- [ ] Unused ingredients from this week's groceries are added to the pantry
- [ ] Next week's plan prefers meals that use these leftovers
display_title: [Check-in] Carry leftover pantry items into next week
